uniform_ratio_definition: ratio of mass-weighted isotope number reservoirs over all valid active cached rows, separately for each original snapshot
uniform_transform: preserve x12C+x13C and x16O+x18O for each row; redistribute between isotopes at the snapshot-wide ratios
scope: direct reference labels for intervention model calibration and selection on original 550/575 only; no fitting or selection on 600 and no x8 direct solves
partition_definition: same particle and all branches in same partition; 25 percent per sampled stratum with at least eight rows; smaller strata training only

future_validation_targets.note: These are prospective screening targets, not claims of passed validation. Assess error in the actual-to-uniform contrast too. Pixel-map validation and x8 intervention coverage remain separate requirements.
